localizedValues.name: SCAR
localizedValues.description:
The Scarborough House comfortably accommodates up to 12 guests. Sleeping accommodations include one room with two queen-size beds, one room with one queen bed, one room with two twin beds, and one room with one twin bed. The spacious living room has three full-size futons, plush couches, Smart Roku TV and WiFi, and opens onto a large porch that faces an old-growth forest. The dining room is stately, and a modern, tiled kitchen offers a comfortable place to prepare culinary delights. No pets or smoking allowed. Cable is not provided.
NOTE: CUT OFF DATE FOR MAKING RESERVATIONS AT THE VACATION HOUSES IS SIX DAYS PRIOR TO ARRIVAL DATE.

localizedValues.name: STEW
localizedValues.description:
Situated on the highest point at the fort, the Steward’s House offers a spectacular view of the Columbia River from a broad open porch. The cozy two-story building, fully refurbished and updated, has retained its lovely original features. Adding to the old-time charm of the building are polished hardwood floors, wooden stairs leading to two bedrooms with queen-size beds and quilted covers, a living room with pressed-tin ceilings, an antique wood stove (converted to propane), and an antique claw-foot bathtub. The living room has a Smart Roku TV and WiFi, and the country-style kitchen has modern appliances. No pets or smoking allowed. Cable is not provided.
NOTE: CUT OFF DATE FOR MAKING RESERVATIONS AT THE VACATION HOUSES IS SIX DAYS PRIOR TO ARRIVAL DATE.
